However, the closed FCSTM (inspection_equivalent_facts.states) is flat: InMotion, Accelerating, Cruising, and Approaching all share the same parent 'llms_emp_feedback_final_0034' with no closed structural containment edge or owned ModelIR ref recording InMotion as the parent of the three substates; the FCSTM text shows only unguarded sibling transitions (InMotion -> Accelerating/Cruising/Approaching), not composite ownership. Because the exact owned ModelIR state ref that would realize InMotion-as-owner is not closed, owner_source_id/owner_model_ref cannot be exact-bound, so this row is returned as unbound with member_domain=unresolved per protocol, while preserving direct_child_states as the sole competent primary reading for D review.

branches.reason: This lens audits root reachability, event-consumer coverage, dead-end/frontier facts, forbidden-scope entry, and stable termination against the closed FCSTM. Key findings: (1) InMotion has no direct terminating path -- fine, InMotion is not a termination contract locus. (2) Stopping is a reachable leaf with zero outgoing transitions (LEAF_WITHOUT_OUTGOING at line:14, W_DEADLOCK_LEAF diagnostic), but no supplied NL contract designates Stopping as a state_role=termination_state nor as an operating state requiring explicit progress, so this is preserved as a derived deadlock/termination-adjacent observation only where a contract's own locus is implicated. (3) The Approaching state_retention (NL10) and state_action progress (NL9-STATEACTION-1) obligations are examined against Approaching's actual outgoing transitions and downstream consequence: Approaching transitions to Stopping (a dead-end leaf) or to [*] (final). The retention obligation requires remaining in Approaching until ready to stop/decelerate; that is satisfied structurally by the two guarded/triggered exits existing. However, NL9-STATEACTION-1 (must_progress, continue approaching destination) is an operating/continuous-activity obligation whose target scope after firing 'Ready to Stop' lands in Stopping, which is a confirmed reachable deadlock leaf (zero outgoing transitions, verify_facts non_proved deadlock:state:Stopping refuted with outgoing_count=0, reference_inspection W_DEADLOCK_LEAF). This is closest bound to the transition_endpoints/termination properties of Stopping's inbound edges (NL2-ENDPOINT-1 and the derived NL9->Approaching->Stopping chain), not to NL9-STATEACTION-1 itself, since state_action/progress is a property of Approaching, not Stopping. I therefore derive a new deadlock_freedom contract on Stopping as the exact operating continuation state entered from two independent required transitions (InMotion->Stopping and Approaching->Stopping), since NL establishes Stopping as a required operating destination but the closed model gives it no outgoing continuation, and no NL contract already states this deadlock_freedom locus. (4) Event-consumer coverage: all 8 declared events have reachable consumers equal to declared consumers per inspection_equivalent_facts; no coverage gap. (5) Root reachability: all 8 states reachable_from_initial=true per verify_facts and inspection facts; no root-reachability defect. (6) Initial entry NL1-INIT-1 (root->DoorsClosing) is satisfied (transition:line:27 exists, resolved_target=DoorsClosing) -- omitted. NL5-INIT-1 (InMotion->Accelerating default entry) is satisfied structurally (transition:line:32, InMotion->Accelerating, unguarded/no trigger) -- omitted since an owner-local edge to the exact target exists. (7) Termination stability: EmergencyStopping->[*] (line 31) and Approaching->[*] (line 39) both exist and route to true final; no NL contract labels either as state_role=termination_state, so no termination candidate is warranted under this round's supplied contracts. For the cardinality contract (NL4-CARD-1 / alias REF-010), the flat FCSTM has no explicit hierarchical containment edge recording InMotion as structural parent of Accelerating/Cruising/Approaching (all states share parent='llms_emp_feedback_final_0034' per inspection_equivalent_facts.states), so no exact owned ModelIR state ref uniquely represents InMotion as the structural owner of that child set in the closed model; I therefore return status=ambiguous/unbound with member_domain=unresolved for the runner, deferring the complete inventory count decision, while preserving direct_child_states as the sole competent primary reading in the reason for D review. All candidates below reflect exact closed-model consequence facts.
